english.title: Promote the holding of an unauthorised trial between motor vehicles on a footpath / bridleway
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) promoted a trial between motor vehicles on a

(A)_[footpath]_
(B)_[bridleway ]_

at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) when the holding of the said trial had not been authorised by the local authority under section 33 of the Road Traffic Act 1988.
english.legislation: Contrary to section 33(3)(a) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
promoted trial between motor vehicles
on footpath/bridleway not authorised by the local authority

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Statement of facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(ii) In the Statement of Facts state the capacity in which the defendant took part in the trial or give details of the nature of the promotion and give details of the number and type of vehicles involved, speeds attained and potential danger to members of the public.
(iii) See also offence wording: H2528.
